answer: One mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a unique hardware vertex fingerprint. Each agent must register a device-unique vertex hash and lock a bond; registering the same vertex twice is detected and slashed. Attackers forging identities must acquire distinct hardware and post fresh bonds per sybil, making each fake costly. A lotus reputation score then decays without activity, while a falcon audit randomly challenges fingerprints, so cheap mass registration fails and honest agents keep standing.
